item.title: Your Portfolio, Explained Simply
item.description: Alex and Sam walk through Venture's plan for the Fidelity trust account: a 60% core of VTI, VTV, and VXUS built over three Mondays, five quality stock starters, cash in a government money market fund, and the ANT shares left alone. Along the way they translate the jargon, including ETFs, expense ratios, dollar-cost averaging, limit and GTC orders, stop-limits, and how 2026 federal taxes treat short-term versus long-term capital gains, qualified versus ordinary dividends, the wash-sale rule, and grantor versus non-grantor trusts.
